scope: Own classical one-CSS-sector matched Poisson adaptation; not original parallel-paper result
pairing: sorted consecutive outgoing directions, old syndrome, one exogenous vertex attempt
RNG: C++ std::mt19937_64 standardized engine; four independent seed-derived streams for waiting time, event kind, noise face, correction site
stream_seeds: SplitMix64 finalizer including golden-ratio addition applied to seed XOR tag; tags1 clock,2 kind,3 noise,4 correction
uniform_integer: unbiased rejection threshold=(-n unsigned64)%n, return raw%n
clock: -log(U)/[L^4*(1+6alpha)]; null attempts included; stop before event exceeding T
geometry: orientation major, axis0 slow vertex indexing; orientations01,02,03,12,13,23; periodic dual lattice
decoder: syndrome-only v1: deterministic connected components, integer lift, strict pairwise wrapped infinity diameter<L/8; axis0,1,2,3 prism in each lifted box if ALL components qualify; otherwise discard partial local filling and dense tensor H of WHOLE syndrome; tensor anchor0,edge seamL-1
score: six cut0 parities on closed accumulated E XOR recovery; any nonzero bit fails
read_accounting: logical syndrome-bit inspections per correction attempt (sweep8,Toom2); excludes decoder/verifier reads and hardware compiler effects
readout_categories: fallback boolean per complete trajectory; components and eligible components also recorded; unresolved0 only after verified boundary; aborts preserved separately
interpretation: 20 finite-time endpoints total; no threshold, asymptotic regime, lifetime, optimal decoder, energy, or hardware equivalence claim
component_tie_break: Start from base vertex of smallest remaining orientation-major edge ID. Breadth-first visit axes0..3 and signs-1,+1. Lift anchor uses stored torus coordinates; local lower corner is coordinate minima. Output face set sorted IDs; prism axis order0..3.
paired_design: Same seed streams per sweep/Toom pair give common proposal times, event types, and physical-noise sites; correction-site map differs. Distinct seeds independent. No pooling of paired methods as independent trials.
build: g++ (Debian14.2.0-19) -O3 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra simulator.cpp -o simulator; Linux x86_64; standard libm floating exponential may vary at rounding level across platforms.
